hints.tr: `day.isocalendar()` üç parçalı bir sonuç veriyor; parçalar `.year`, `.week`, `.weekday` ile okunuyor.
hints.en: `day.isocalendar()` returns a three-part result; the parts are read with `.year`, `.week`, `.weekday`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
from datetime import date

days = ["2024-03-09", "2024-12-29", "2024-12-30", "2025-01-01", "2021-01-01"]

for text in days:
    day = date.fromisoformat(text)
    iso = day.isocalendar()
    print(text, f"{iso.year}-W{iso.week:02d}")
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
from datetime import date

days = ["2024-03-09", "2024-12-29", "2024-12-30", "2025-01-01", "2021-01-01"]

for text in days:
    day = date.fromisoformat(text)
    iso = day.isocalendar()
    print(text, f"{iso.year}-W{iso.week:02d}")
```
